candidateContents.tickets: Release: master commit a3fb1b8207cad4b4ce9bea3c69c54637a0e8ecb5, version 0.0.30; includes DEV-102 mindmap layouts, product documentation on the website, welcome-page getting-started entry, and release-gate repair.
highlights: Product documentation now ships on the official website at /docs and /zh/docs, sourced from repository Markdown under docs/user-guide; docs index, chapter pages, per-page canonical/hreflang metadata, 404 fallback, and in-page TOC anchors are implemented. The legacy docs/user-guide.md is retired and replaced by a chaptered bilingual Getting Started page.

Welcome page 快速上手 now opens the official Getting Started documentation in the system default browser, with URL language following the configured UI language (zh-CN -> /zh/docs/getting-started, en-US -> /docs/getting-started). It reuses the existing Electron window-open guard to shell.openExternal and adds no new IPC. The in-app guided tour remains available via first-run auto-open and Settings replay.

DEV-102 mindmap layout structures (right/left/up/down/fishbone/X) ship with sidecar persistence, real-pipeline integration tests, and ADR-0020; ADR-0021 through ADR-0025 record the website docs, welcome-page link, desktop/mobile i18n, and screenshot platform decisions with CONTEXT.md vocabulary.

Test gate repair: mindmap-layout-integration previously passed all assertions but exited non-zero because happy-dom 20.14 ancestor validation throws a TypeError when simple-mind-map/svg.js first mounts a fresh detached SVG group. The test now retries only that TypeError through happy-dom's internal validated appendChild path; real insertion still executes and other exceptions are not swallowed. pnpm test is exit code 0 with 1779 passed | 3 skipped.
Release hygiene: lint zero errors/warnings, typecheck 5/5, electron-vite build, website build, verify-release-config 31/31, and version/tag match all pass at the release candidate.
